source.name: Volkswagen fluid capacity data
source.note: Read from Volkswagen's table of engine oil capacities, filed with NHTSA; it gives only the oil capacity for these years. Check it against the manual for your own car.
source.basis: Facts from Volkswagen's own Job Aid of engine oil capacities by model year (MC-10121998, filed with NHTSA). Only the figure is taken. No fluid chart for these years was found, so nothing else is given.
